title: Slovakian Sausage and Dumplings
description: A hearty German-inspired dish featuring Slovakian sausage, served with fluffy dumplings.
instructions: 2. Cook Slovakian sausage in a pan over medium-high heat until browned, then set aside.
3. In a large bowl, combine dumpling mix, flour, egg, and melted butter. Mix until a dough forms.
4. Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead for 5 minutes.
5. Divide dough into 8-10 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten slightly.
6. In a large Dutch oven or pot, bring 2 cups of water to a boil. Add Slovakian sausage and cook for 5 minutes.
7. Add the dumplings to the pot and cover with a lid. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until dumplings are cooked through.
8. While the dumplings cook, melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
9. Add minced garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
10. Serve the cooked dumplings with the Slovakian sausage and pan-fried onion and garlic mixture.
